lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Columbus businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Columbus is Ohio's capital and its largest city, a growing, white-collar metro with a huge university at its centre and prosperous suburbs around the outerbelt. We plan marketing for the customers you are trying to win, whether they are students near High Street or homeowners in Dublin.

sections.heading: A city of offices, campuses and warehouses
paragraphs: Columbus never depended on heavy industry the way other Ohio cities did. Its economy rests on state government, Ohio State University and its medical centre, a large insurance and banking sector, research organisations and the head offices of well-known retail and restaurant brands. Fashion and consumer retail companies have long been based here, which has left the city with deep talent in merchandising, design and e-commerce.

Location matters too. A large part of the country's population is within a day's drive, so distribution centres ring the metro, especially around Rickenbacker to the south and along the interstates. Vehicle manufacturing in nearby Marysville supports a network of suppliers, and new technology investment to the east in Licking County is drawing contractors and housing in that direction.

sections.heading: Neighbourhoods and the outerbelt suburbs
paragraphs: Inside the city, each district has a character of its own. The Short North is galleries, restaurants and boutiques along High Street. German Village is brick streets and historic homes. The Arena District and downtown fill up on event nights, Franklinton is attracting studios and new offices, and Clintonville and Grandview are established residential areas with busy local shops. The University District runs on the academic calendar.

Much of the household spending, though, sits around Interstate 270: Dublin, Hilliard, Upper Arlington, Worthington, Westerville, Gahanna, New Albany, Grove City and Pickerington, with large retail centres at Easton and Polaris. Residents there search by suburb name, and they expect a business to say plainly whether it serves them.
bullets: Area pages for the suburbs you cover, written with real detail about each one.
A complete Google Business Profile with accurate service areas and regular new reviews.
Ad budgets split by area so you can compare Dublin with Grove City.
Landing pages matched to each ad, with one clear next step.
Call and form tracking tied back to sales.

sections.heading: A young, growing and well-informed audience
paragraphs: Columbus keeps adding people, many of them graduates who stay and professionals who relocate for work. New arrivals need a doctor, a dentist, a vet, a mechanic and a contractor, and they find them through search and reviews instead of family tradition. The city's long history as a test market also means residents have seen every kind of promotion. Straight information, fair pricing signals and proof from other customers do better than big claims.
With so many students and young workers, short video and social content carry weight for restaurants, fitness, housing and entertainment.

sections.heading: Football Saturdays and the rest of the year
paragraphs: Ohio State home games reshape the city on autumn Saturdays. Traffic, hotel rooms, restaurant tables and attention all bend toward the stadium, and businesses either plan offers around the game or schedule around it. Late summer brings move-in and the State Fair, the legislature's sessions fill downtown hotels and lunch spots, and winter cold and spring storms set the workload for heating, roofing and basement firms. We build those dates into content calendars and budgets in advance.

faqs.a: No. We work with Columbus businesses remotely and keep in touch through scheduled video calls, shared documents and regular reporting.

faqs.q: How do I show up for searches in Dublin, Westerville or Hilliard?
faqs.a: Create a useful page for each suburb you serve, set your service area in your business profile, collect reviews from customers in those places and aim ads at each area separately.

faqs.q: How should I market around Ohio State game days?
faqs.a: Decide whether fans are your customers. If they are, prepare offers, ads and posts ahead of home games and target the campus and downtown areas. If not, avoid launching on those Saturdays, when attention is elsewhere.

faqs.q: What does it cost to hire a digital marketing agency in Columbus?
faqs.a: It depends on what you need done and how competitive your field is locally. After a free consultation we send a quote based on that scope.

faqs.q: How quickly can a Columbus campaign start producing leads?
faqs.a: Timing depends on your requirements, the channels chosen and what already exists. We agree the timeline with you in the plan before work starts.
